notes: The second מִן takes the *of* of *of the sin offering*, the ASV having written a word for each preposition's own relation (rule 11); treating that *of* as belonging to the first phrase would leave a written preposition with no rendering against rule 2.
The directive he of הַמִּזְבֵּחָה (tag Sd) takes *upon* as its own unit under rule 32, the article and noun keeping *the* and *altar*.
The opening waw takes the ASV's *but* under rule 14.
